data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: sprint SKILL.md per-task sub-agent dispatch template (around line 1513) does not explicitly require sub-agents to execute COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md inline (vs raw git commit). per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 4 already specifies the correct pattern but the orchestrator's batch dispatch scaffold does not enforce it down to the per-task prompt. Two related dimensions per ticket comment: (1) LLM-behavioral fix in SKILL.md prompt scaffold; (2) hook non-inheritance in worktree-isolated sub-agents — separate follow-up. Classification: MODERATE — SKILL.md prompt-template edit + a test validating the template text. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
